protocol.evaluation: Six-case development smoke; no GT accuracy claim; model loading excluded.

methodology.selection: Six selected development examples with stage contrasts, changes, known approval, revocation scope and deadlines.
methodology.timing_boundary: Cold Python analyze_and_resolve(), including FAISS and all three fresh model calls; excludes model loading, HTTP and rendering. Two tickets at a time after case 14.
methodology.iteration: An initial six-case run exposed omitted last-known-good fields and an overstated known mapping. Prompts were tightened before these six fresh calls.
methodology.checks: All stages valid, three calls per ticket, original Top-50 retained, exact current quotations, signal snapshot persistence, literal historical verification excerpts.
methodology.reviewer: Coding agent qualitative inspection; no expert outcome labels.

qualitative_review.observation: Separates the correct preview from failed PDF generation, preserves release-blocking impact, and proposes sourced conditional template remediation plus PDF checks.
qualitative_review.remaining_limit: The release-status question and production-path checks are suggestions for review, not independently established requirements.

qualitative_review.observation: Separates current detail pages from the stale overview, preserves the preceding rule update and manual workaround, and asks which rule changed.
qualitative_review.remaining_limit: Some missing-check wording mentions possible refresh/cache mechanisms; their existence is not established by the ticket.

qualitative_review.observation: Keeps manager approval and standard-role restrictions satisfied; asks for the exact target user account instead of asking for approval again.
qualitative_review.remaining_limit: The known role still needs mapping to an actual account/profile; no applicable historical procedure was selected.

qualitative_review.observation: Preserves direct, synchronized and inherited revocation scope plus the original end-of-day wording. Requests the missing contractor identity.
qualitative_review.remaining_limit: No historical revocation procedure was selected; diagnostics and clarification do not complete offboarding.

qualitative_review.observation: Separates working order creation from failed routing, preserves the broker-change trigger, and marks the exact mapping as missing rather than checked.
qualitative_review.remaining_limit: Mapping/routing defects remain hypotheses. The text says a workaround is required, which does not establish that it is available or effective.

qualitative_review.observation: Separates completed matching from missing acknowledgements; listener status stays unknown and restart/replay remains conditional.
qualitative_review.remaining_limit: A diagnostic card also asks whether acknowledgements are absent upstream; this is a question, not a confirmed change in failure location.

limits: Development checks, not held-out GT accuracy or proof of improvement.
This is not an A/B test against the earlier implementation.
Structured signal correctness and question usefulness still need human review.
The earlier 3.61-second Resolve-only measurement used saved analysis; do not compare it directly with this complete workflow.
Browser tests use deterministic fixtures; visual inspection replays a real current case-14 result.
